DaemonProbeState.description: Outcome of asking the installed `ta-daemon` for its own facts.

oneOf.description: The daemon answered; its facts are in the capability fields.
No `ta-daemon` binary was found next to `ta` or on PATH.

The binary exists but does not understand `--print-capabilities`: a
daemon built before the probe existed. Its capabilities are reported
false because nothing proves them.

The binary ran but its answer could not be used (crash, timeout,
unreadable or unsupported probe version).

DaemonProbeStatus.description: How the daemon-side capabilities were obtained.

binary.description: The `ta-daemon` binary that was asked, when one was found.

detail.description: What happened and what to do about it; empty when `state` is `ok`.

Platform.description: Operating system and CPU architecture this `ta` was built for.

SandboxProviderFact.description: A sandbox provider usable on this machine and the capabilities it enforces.

enforces.description:
Capability names (`fs.deny_ta_tree`, `net.loopback_blocked`, ...) the
provider enforces, computed from the same matrix a real launch uses.

description:
`ta capabilities --json`: what this installation can safely do.

Every boolean is true only when the code path behind it was exercised and
worked (see `evidence`); a flag appearing in `--help` never counts.

atomic_apply.description: Apply journals prior values and a failed apply restores them.

capabilities_schema.description: Version of the capability field set; installers gate on this.

daemon_passes_restricted_flags.description:
The installed daemon launches CoS roles with `--chat-mode` and
`--origin cos`, and this `ta run` accepts and acts on them. False when
no daemon could be asked.

daemon_probe.description: How the daemon-side capabilities were obtained.

evidence.description: Per capability, what was run to decide it (or why it is false).

nats_credentials.description: The daemon's NATS client enforces credentials for non-loopback servers.

outcome_roles.description: The daemon grants the outcome right only to the configured roles.

rules_engine.description: The compiled rules table decides actions and defaults to deny when unattended.

sandbox_providers.description: Sandbox providers usable on this machine (empty when none).

schema_version.description: Shape version of this document (same value as `capabilities_schema`).

supports_chat_mode.description: `ta run --chat-mode` starts a read-only chat-mode launch.

supports_origin.description: `ta run --origin <name>` validates and stamps the goal origin.

ta_version.description:
`ta` version. NOT a capability signal: builds before and after the CoS
hardening report the same version.

terms_status.description: `ta terms-status --json` reports a document version and content hash.

title: CapabilitiesReport
